title: A Vow for the Garden
author: Jude Zhou
blurb: Zephyrine Sterling, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
